messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-84912 — synth-check 'synth-eu-llm-health' failing (3/5 consecutive) in eu-west-1. Probe timeout 504s. auto-escalation in 5m. https://pagerduty.example/PD-84912

pagerduty: Incident created PD-84912 · urgent · assigned to #sre-oncall

lucy: acked on PD and taking initial triage. jumping into probe logs.

devon: saw a spike in probe latency earlier, might be downstream DB timeouts? checking mem/CPU on inference pool.

sre-oncall: @lucy @devon thanks — if it's a canary-only issue we can pause probe fanout while we investigate. can someone check synthetic dashboard (redwood-console -> synths -> eu-west-1)?

lucy: looking now — dashboard shows 100% 504s for the last 4m, request latency median 3.1s -> tails hitting 20s then 504. no deploys in the last hour per deploy-bot.

ops-shift: rolling logs from the probe runner: ```
2026-03-14T15:04:01Z synth-eu-llm-health request id=abc123 status=504 target=eu03 latency=20001ms error="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-14T15:04:31Z synth-eu-llm-health request id=abc124 status=504 target=eu03 latency=21000ms error="kv-cache miss & slow fetch"
```

devon: tagging the inference pool eu03 — showing high CPU on one node, but only ~60% overall. memory normal. NVidia driver reports repeated cuda context resets on host eu03-12.

lucy: could be a GPU flake. can we fail traffic to eu03 and reroute synths to eu02?

sre-oncall: yes. plan: 1) pause synth fanout for eu-west-1 2) update probe routing to exclude eu03 3) trigger short canary in eu02 to validate. doing step 1 now.

incident-bot: synth-fanout paused for eu-west-1 by sre-oncall. reason: probe storm while investigating.

devon: routing change applied: synths -> eu02 only. running a single test invocation: `curl -sS https://synth-runner.internal/run?synth=synth-eu-llm-health`

ops-shift: first test to eu02 returned 200 in 430ms. second is 210ms. looks normal.

lucy: marking PD with note: routing workaround applied, impact limited to probes and internal monitoring. marking customer impact: none observed.

pagerduty: PD-84912 acknowledged by lucy (sre-oncall). auto-escalation cancelled.

tara: heads-up for handoff — i'm taking over at 15:10Z for ongoing remediation and RCA start. will coordinate with infra to repro GPU resets.

sre-oncall: thanks @tara. next steps: open host incident for eu03-12 with infra, collect nvidia logs `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and kernel dmesg. tagging infra-oncall.

devon: grabbing logs and will attach snippet to PD. early dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID 4123` repeated 50 times in 10m.

ops-shift: escalated host-level incident to infra: INF-3047. infra-oncall replied and is looking at hardware flake.

lucy: for post-incident: propose probe routing fallback: if one host in pool reports >20% cuda resets in 5m, automatically exclude host from synth routing. also add a warm-start probe to validate after failover.

tara: agreed. adding to action items. I'll own the RCA doc and summary for customer ops if needed.

incident-bot: Incident PD-84912 updated: status=acknowledged, mitigations=probe-routing-excluded-eu03, probe-fanout-paused, host-escalation-INF-3047.

lucy: handoff note — leaving the channel. @tara has the lead. ping me for any questions. :white_check_mark:

tara: taking over. I'll post updates in PD and channel as infra replies. closing the thread for active paging; reopen if alerts resume. :wave:
